item.tib: zab don gsang ba'i snying po las dran pa tshe yi sgrub pa
item.coloph: ces pa tshe g.yang kha sprod kyi tshe sgrub 'di ni/ byang gi phag mo g.yu mtsho nas gter du drangs shing phyis su dbang mo dang nye gnas mang pos bkur (bskyal) ngor/ gsang sngags gling pas phab cing / yi ge pa ni dge bshes g.yung drung ye shes kyis bgyis pas/ 'gro kun 'chi med tshe yi sku ru gyur par shog cig gu/
